negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most deadline-dense non-NBU source for banks and PSPs cannot be collected with a plain fetcher; a headless-browser path or open-data/mirror fallback must be budgeted.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Ukrainian for a non-NBU consumer-protection supervisor over banks (Держпродспоживслужба, АМКУ).
negative_findings.result_summary: Держпродспоживслужба's own publications state that supervision of banks' compliance with financial-services consumer-protection law and financial advertising (outside the stock market) belongs to the National Bank of Ukraine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumed 'consumer-protection rulings on financial services' would be a non-NBU stream; for banks it largely is not. Retail-conduct enforcement must be tracked in the NBU cell, and this cell should not double-count it.

negative_findings.description: Searched (uk) for an AMCU public-consultation / draft-regulatory-act portal analogous to the NSSMC's регуляторна діяльність section.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated AMCU consultation portal surfaced; draft amendments (e.g. to the Положення про концентрацію) appear only as ordinary news items on amcu.gov.ua, and cross-body coverage sits with the Державна регуляторна служба.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: AMCU consultation deadlines are only discoverable via unstructured news monitoring plus DRS, which raises miss risk for merger-rule changes affecting bank M&A.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a searchable, full-text AMCU decision database (as opposed to dated news bulletins).
negative_findings.result_summary: Only news-style summaries of decisions and разпорядження were found on amcu.gov.ua, plus legacy query-string listing URLs. No open, queryable decisions register was located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Full reasoning on bank/acquiring cases has to be recovered indirectly from the court register or trade press, which adds latency and interpretation risk.

brief: Ukraine's non-NBU supervisory burden on banks and PSPs is split across three unrelated domains with three different vocabularies: NSSMC (nssmc.gov.ua) for capital-markets rules, AMCU (amcu.gov.ua) for merger clearance and payments-market competition cases, and the SFMS/FIU (fiu.gov.ua, with normative acts issued as Ministry of Finance orders) for AML/CFT reporting mechanics. NSSMC is the most tractable — bilingual, with a predictable weekly 'ключові рішення' bulletin and an explicit regulatory-activity/consultation section — while AMCU publishes only unstructured dated news bulletins with no queryable decisions register, and the SFMS portal refused automated fetching (HTTP 403, treated as bot-defended rather than dead). The reliable spine for binding text and effective dates is zakon.rada.gov.ua, backed by drs.gov.ua for cross-authority draft acts, data.gov.ua for SFMS open data, and the court register plus SRO associations (ПАРД, УАІБ) as indirect corroboration. One cell assumption did not hold: consumer-protection supervision of banks sits with the NBU, not with Держпродспоживслужба or the AMCU, so that stream should be tracked in the NBU cell instead.
